description: The world's input channels, the movement and action set every binding and kit names; the engine declares none of its own.

items.description: One row of the world's channel table — the intent vector's declared vocabulary (see PlayerIntent). The consumer is exactly one of Role (an engine motion channel, claimable by at most one channel) or Composition (a kit composition trigger, bound — or left inert — per kit via Actions).

name.description: The channel's unique, non-empty name — the vocabulary key every binding, body.press, kit Actions entry, and the addon wire resolve against.

shape.description: The declared value shape: bipolar [-1, 1], unipolar [0, 1], or binary.
shape.title: ChannelShape

x-enumDescriptions.Binary: A bit: exactly {0, 1} once quantized. Edges derive from the value crossing the channel's threshold against the previous sub-step (see Puck.World.Server.WorldBody's per-channel edge tracking) — never carried.
x-enumDescriptions.Relative: A Q32.32 displacement accumulated since the preceding input submission, consumed once.
x-enumDescriptions.Text: Ordered Unicode scalar events with no held value or numeric/button storage.

role.description: The engine motion role this channel claims, or null for a composition channel.
role.title: ChannelRole

x-enumDescriptions.MoveStrafe: Motion along the body's right, +1 right / -1 left.
x-enumDescriptions.Turn: The heading turn rate, +1 left (counter-clockwise about the body's up) / -1 right. The grounded program integrates it into the heading scalar the attitude derives from; the free program reads it as the yaw rate beside Pitch/Roll.
x-enumDescriptions.MoveUp: Motion along the body's up, +1 up / -1 down.
x-enumDescriptions.Pitch: Pitch rate about the body's right, +1 nose-up / -1 nose-down.
x-enumDescriptions.Roll: Roll rate about the body's forward axis, +1 banks left (the body's right rises) / -1 right.
x-enumDescriptions.FaceX: The world +X component of a commanded facing direction — with FaceY and FaceZ a world-frame vector; nonzero, it is the direction the body faces this tick, ahead of movement-facing. All zero commands nothing.
x-enumDescriptions.FaceY: The world +Y (up) component of a commanded facing direction. Carried so the commanded facing rides as a whole vector; no motion op reads it yet — the yaw snap takes its angle from the planar pair alone.
x-enumDescriptions.FaceZ: The world +Z component of a commanded facing direction (see FaceX).
x-enumDescriptions.MoveX: The world +X component of a commanded movement direction — with MoveY and MoveZ a full world-frame vector. Claimed, it supersedes the MoveAdvance/MoveStrafe pair whenever it is nonzero.
x-enumDescriptions.MoveY: The world +Y component of a commanded movement direction (see MoveX).
x-enumDescriptions.MoveZ: The world +Z component of a commanded movement direction (see MoveX).

composition.description: Whether this channel is a kit-composition trigger. Exactly one of Role or this must be set.

threshold.description: The binary crossing threshold in [0, 1] raw units (binary channels only); null takes DefaultBinaryThreshold (One/2).

frame.description: What the MoveAdvance/MoveStrafe pair is relative to when a binding row folds into it (see ChannelFrame); the two roles must declare the same frame, and every other channel leaves it at World. Omitted from a saved document at that default.
frame.title: ChannelFrame

x-enumDescriptions.World: Raw world axes — what the sim reads; the kit's own MoveFrame/FacingSnap decide the rest.
x-enumDescriptions.Camera: Relative to the seat's camera yaw — latched the tick movement begins, so the camera may orbit mid-run without steering — and the body's HEADING turns to the way it moves (the seat composes the direction into the FaceX/FaceZ roles) — the third-person scheme.
x-enumDescriptions.Heading: Relative to the body's own heading, which the Turn role steers and movement never turns — the keyboard scheme: strafe sidesteps (the drawn attitude angling toward the travel under the kit's facing snap, the heading intact), turn turns, the camera is its own control.

relative.description: Required units, sensitivity and limit for Relative channels; absent on levels.

unit.description: An authored unit name shared by producers and consumers.

sensitivity.description: Units per device sample, applied before host quantization.

maximumPerStep.description: The positive absolute displacement limit in authored units.

relative.title: WorldRelativeChannel

items.title: WorldChannel
